verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents a first-party 'Tailscale skill' that lets a coding agent work with Tailscale configuration and code. That gives a user an official, if agent-mediated, path to operating Tailscale through natural-language instructions, but the evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on what the skill can actually do. The llms.txt file and the Aperture LLM-gateway features are adjacent and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product itself, documentation of which operations the skill covers, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install the Tailscale skill so a coding agent can work with Tailscale configuration and code.
